headline: Study Suggests China Holds Untapped Lithium Resources Near Battery Plants
summary: According to a new study, China may possess significant untapped lithium deposits located beneath its battery manufacturing plants, potentially boosting its position in critical battery metals.
why: China is the world's leading manufacturer of electric vehicle batteries. Domestic lithium reserves could reduce reliance on imported raw materials for clean energy supply chains.

impacts.name: Lithium Mining & Processing
impacts.why: Discovery of accessible domestic reserves could expand local extraction and refining opportunities.
